drive.description: Drive identifier (for example drive8). Limits depend on op.

attachmentMode.description: How the firmware attaches the mounted image.

location.description: device (default): Ultimate path. host: upload the image from the host (needs verify false; type from the extension).

driveMode.description: Drive emulation mode to switch to during verification.

verify.description: Power on, reset and verify via the reliability workflow.

powerOnIfNeeded.description: Power on the drive before mounting (verify=true).

tracks.description: Track count (D64 supports 35 to 41; DNP requires explicit tracks).

root.description: Root path to search Limits depend on op.

waitMs.description: Delay after firmware run before returning

captureCandidates.description: Include up to this many candidates in result

description:
Disk operations.

Operations:
- list_drives: List drive slots and mounted images.
- mount [write]: Mount a disk image, optionally verifying. Required inputs: drive, image. Optional inputs: type, attachmentMode, location, driveMode, verify, powerOnIfNeeded, resetAfterMount, maxRetries, retryDelayMs.
- unmount [c64u, u2] [write]: Unmount the image from a drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- file_info [c64u, u2]: Inspect a file on the Ultimate filesystem. Required inputs: path.
- create_image [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Create a blank disk image. Fails if the file already exists. Required inputs: format, path. Optional inputs: diskname, tracks.
- find_and_run [c64u, u2] [write]: Find a PRG/CRT by name substring and run the first match. Required inputs: nameContains. Optional inputs: root, extensions, caseInsensitive, sort, waitMs, captureCandidates.
- find_paths [c64u, u2]: Find Ultimate storage paths containing a name substring; runs nothing. Required inputs: nameContains. Optional inputs: root, extensions, maxResults, caseInsensitive.
